name: processing-worker
description: S3-event-triggered post-upload processing (§9.3): thumbnail generation, basic metadata extraction, virus-scan stub. Deliberately pure-JS dependencies only (no native bindings) so the same package works unmodified whether it's installed on the dev host or inside the Lambda's Linux execution container.
comment: index.js requires @aws-sdk/client-s3 at runtime but it is NOT bundled into the deployment zip (see infrastructure/localstack/init-aws.sh) — the Lambda Node.js runtime image ships the AWS SDK v3 pre-installed, exactly so functions don't need to carry it themselves. It's listed under devDependencies only so `npm install` still provides it for local editing/type-checking.
